features.baseline: 2024 annual net runs per game(home)-same(away), fixed throughout 2025; reuses sealed annual-source identity/chronology checks.
features.history_rules: Only source-supported completed games with no later completion, forfeit, protest or postponement. Unknown postponed/rescheduled status is excluded, never inferred false from absent field. Target must satisfy same event-status admission.
features.single_added: 2025 admissible lagged wins(home)/games(home)-wins(away)/games(away); no smoothing, no windows or tuning.
features.standardization: Train-admitted rows only; per-feature mean/population SD, zero SD uses1, both models same training rows.

fit.solver: Fixed damped Newton, zero init, max100 iterations, max20 backtracking halves, Armijo1e-4, gradient infinity norm<=1e-8; no alternatives.

postponement_proof_contract.available: No such 2025 source found in existing repo fixtures or legacy data; current sources must remain blocked under the all-postponements-excluded instruction.
postponement_proof_contract.required: Explicit source-backed originally scheduled date plus actual played date and rescheduled/postponed status, matched unique full physical game identity; plain as-played dates and blank Retrosheet field14 do not prove never-postponed.

raw_field_documentation.field14: Later-date completion/suspension/upheld protest information, not original planned date or a postponement indicator.
raw_field_documentation.field161: Y means complete game information acquired; it is not an original scheduling assertion.

reject_rule: Reject if candidate accuracy<=baseline or candidate Brier>baseline or candidate logloss>baseline. Passing is only development, requires new data and same-game market validation.

split.algorithm: First sorted source date whose cumulative raw game count reaches ceil(0.60*N), train includes entire boundary date; evaluation strictly later. Dates/counts only, not labels or metrics.
